title: Create 010 Editor Binary Template for USDZ File Format
description:
Introduction:
The objective of this project is to create an 010 Editor Binary Template file for the USDZ file format. The USDZ file format is a container file format used to store and exchange 3D assets and is developed by Pixar Animation Studios.

Deliverables:
The expected deliverable for this project is an 010 Editor Binary Template file that correctly parses the USDZ file format. The template file must meet the following requirements:

* Correctly parse the USDZ file format according to the specification provided at https://graphics.pixar.com/usd/release/spec_usdz.html
* Ability to correctly parse USD assets from Pixar's "UsdSkelExamples", "kitchen set", and "city set"
* Ability to correctly parse all the USDZ files available at https://developer.apple.com/augmented-reality/quick-look/

Technical Requirements:

The template file should be compatible with the latest version of 010 Editor.

Testing:
The deliverable will be tested against the assets mentioned above to ensure that it correctly parses the USDZ file format and provides the expected output.

Timeframe:
The estimated timeframe for the completion of this project is 2 weeks from the start date.

Budget:
The budget for this project is $500. This includes all costs associated with the project, such as software licenses, etc.

title: Opportunity for MLOPS Engineer: Serve a wav2vec Speech Recognition Model through Triton Server
description:
We are looking for a talented MLOPS engineer to work on a challenging speech recognition project. The project has a tight deadline of 5 days. The tasks involved are:

Based on the wav2vec2 model available in the repository lgris/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-open-brazilian-portuguese-v2, convert it to ONNX and TensorRT
Evaluate the WER of the model in TensorRT compared to the original model in Hugginface
Create a Dockerfile with the Triton server configured with an endpoint to consume the model in TensorRT
Create a Dockerfile with a Python server using socket.io to send audio to the Triton server for inference
Create a Dockerfile with a JavaScript client sending audio from the microphone to the Python server, from Python to the Triton server through GRPC, and back to the browser with the transcription
Create a Docker Compose file with the three services communicating with each other and ready for testing
Compare the inference times of the PyTorch model served directly from Python, the TensorRT model served directly from Python, and the model served through the TensorRT server
Evaluate the latency of the communication between the Python server and the TensorRT server
The goal is to perform audio inference captured from the user's microphone in browser through socket.io communication with the Python server and then from this to the Triton server to be able to receive multiple concurrent requests from different users
Attention should be paid in the Python server to have a session for each user, so that the streaming audio can be returned to the user who sent the audio.
If you have the skills and experience to tackle this project, we would love to hear from you. Please apply with your portfolio and relevant experience. Time is of the essence, so apply as soon as possible.

- Execution of order should happen via the interactive brokers API
- A scientific paper implementing a similar hybrid model (LSTM + LightGBM) can be found here: https://www.matec-conferences.org/articles/matecconf/pdf/2021/05/matecconf_cscns20_05011.pdf

Industries: Construction, Measurement, Craftsmanship, Carpentry, Painting
The app provides the 3D visualization of apartments/rooms etc. in order for individual lengths, heights, and widths of elements or entire spaces to be presented in different units of measurement. As an example, everything should be clickable or selectable via gestures - e.g. from one end of the ceiling to the other, one should be able to click/select both ends and receive information on its dimensions. The estimation should be then delivered for craftsmen based on the result of measurement of the selected and calculated space e.g. for painters, carpenters, plumbers, etc. All measurement results should be savable for later use and they should be presentable in different elements (walls, windows, floors, room, apartment complex, buildings, levels (level 1, 2, 3)…) and different units (mm, cm, m, sqm…). An example of that would be canvas.io. 

👨‍💻Technologies needed:
* Game designer competence
* Knowledge of CAD design
* Know about gesture interactions on tablet
* change parameters and select objects in 3D space
* use of color and shape in 3D space
* Develop a design language for B2B business
* Knowledge of UX Design in 3D Space (gesture design)
* Create interaction that lowers the cognitive burden
* User research-driven UX

Working ethodology will be discussed prior to the development phase - nothing specific for conception

🙂 Soft skills needed:
Proactive
Solution-Oriented
Critical Thinking
Solid English skills

🛠Tools: Slack, Jira, Confluence, Miro

⚙Responsibilities/Duties: 
Estimating and conception of a 3D Mobile Based application and development of a prototype. Program and configure an initial version of the 3D interface including gestures and object interaction.

❔First Task
- Deciding on which system to be used - cost-effective, easily implementable, easy usability
- Deciding on whether one system should be used (e.g. Apple AR or equivalent to Android) or if it should be applicable to both iOS and Android
- Conception and estimation of tickets for prototype - rough estimations (should be as clearly defined as possible for a sales structure) but due to limited hourly budget, it is not anticipated to go into great details
- After this is done, we await the client to approve the budget for prototype development - development starts then

📝Other tasks to tackle:
1. Develop the prototype of an application for mobile devices with which 3D measurements can be taken based on 3D scanning device(s)
2. The solution/goal is to transfer the data volume from a scanner/laser/lidar to a mobile device. That should be rendered by a 3D engine and replicate rendered wireframes. These measurements should be selectable (i.e. wall 1, wall 2, ceiling, floor, etc.) with a 360 view. The goal is to achieve square meter figures that should provide craftsmen with information to deduce estimations from it.
3. We are delivering a prototype at this stage with which the client wants to attract investors in order to initiate phase 2, which would be the development of a sophisticated app. This prototype should be able to perform successfully during live presentations.
4. Aside from development, we need to consult the client as to what is possible within an MVP, what stack is to be used, and what features are required in MVP, helping with orchestrating the pitch event.
5. 
a) Unity Developer
b) Unreal Engine Developer
c) Rhino with Grasshopper Developer
d) Houdini Developer
Alternatively Apple AR Kit or equivalent Android solution (ideally)
6. BA, CSM

📒Note:
We are only looking to work with an individual freelancer who would need to pass our assessments (soft and hard skills). You would have direct communication with us therefore we are not working with a middleman (PM, agency owner, etc.).

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
## About BetterBrain:

[BetterBrain](http://betterbrain.ai) is an on-demand Data Concierge that uses [generative AI](https://www.sequoiacap.com/article/generative-ai-a-creative-new-world/) to answer companies' data and analytics questions. We make it easy for operations, marketing, and product teams to ask questions in Slack/MS Teams, get answers, and generate insights 10x faster for a fraction of the cost. 

BetterBrain securely ingests different types of data across a company’s stack to codify institutional knowledge, and then uses generative AI with a human-in-the-loop to answer questions fast (all AI responses are vetted to ensure accuracy). 

**BetterBrain is a VC-backed startup evolving business intelligence with next-generation AI. Our mission is to create the first truly self-serve data and analytics platform. We're looking for exceptional individuals interested in solving hard problems.**

## About the opportunity:

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced data analyst to join our team and help us deliver value to our clients as we build our generative AI system. **This is a unique role to join as a founding team member for a generative AI startup poised to completely transform the business intelligence space. You will be instrumental in bringing our first product to market and establishing the foundation for its future growth.**

An ideal candidate will start as an individual contributor and eventually grow to lead our data organization. If you are a senior-level candidate with a passion for data and analytics and want to be part of a dynamic, fast-growing AI startup, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. 

While this is a remote-first opportunity, we're currently focusing on candidates within the Americas to better align with our working hours as a team.

## What you’ll do:

- Generate complex queries to answer data and analytics questions for our clients, using your deep understanding of modern data stacks and business intelligence
- Evaluate and test AI queries to ensure accuracy and completeness, providing guidance as needed
- Build documentation to improve the efficiency of our AI query generation
- Build systems and processes to improve time-to-insight for our clients, using your ability to identify and solve problems
- Interact with business users to understand their needs and provide timely, accurate responses to their questions

## Your qualifications:

Technical fit:

- Extensive experience as a data analyst, with a proven track record of success in interacting with business users to answer their questions effectively and efficiently
- Mastery of SQL
- Experience with tools in the modern data stack such as DBT, DWHs, data catalogs, and data visualization tools
- Python experience is a plus

Culture fit:

- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including business users and engineers
- Good troubleshooting skills and the ability to work well independently with minimal supervision
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and focus on getting stuff done
- Startup experience is a plus

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway - we look forward to hearing from you!

## Why join us

- 🤓 **Experienced team**. Work closely with an experienced founding team with support from a roster of impressive investors/advisors, including On Deck, Hustle Fund, and even Adam Grant.
- 🎯 **High-impact work**. Do meaningful work that makes a difference. BetterBrain is tackling an ambitious mission to reimagine the business intelligence industry.
- 🛠️ **Learning & autonomy**. We want you to grow more in this role than in any other job you've had. We'll do our best to guide and support you, but ultimately we trust you to further our mission.

title: Instagram Bot Phyton
description:
Hello

PLEASE, READ CAREFULLY (I am not asking for a copy paste of your skills)

I want to build a bot for Instagram with a similar structure which I have attached here.
Let me know if you are able to build it and have it working.
I am interested in: 
Your successful projects are related to this work. 
The time and cost you consider for this project

DELIVERABLES MUST INCLUDE:

Ability to specify the working time for the bot
Ability to fetch comments and accounts from the database
Ability to scrape followers and save them into a separate table
Ability to randomly select accounts to interact with
Ability to perform a variety of interactions, including follow, like, and comment
Ability to randomly view 20% of the stories from the accounts it interacts with
Ability to use a combination of unique and combined interactions
Ability to limit the number of comments to one per account
Ability to vary the number of likes between 1 and 5
Ability to ensure that followers of selected accounts have no numbers in their names and have between 250 and 4000 followers
Ability to randomly vary the number of interactions from 30 to 170
Ability to have a higher activity (a 20%) during weekends
Ability to randomly follow and unfollow accounts based on specific rules
Ability to report all daily activity, including the number of comments, likes, and accounts followed
Ability to remind the user to change the accounts to interact with every two weeks

IN TERMS OF DESIGN 

User flows: A detailed user flow chart that outlines how the user will interact with the bot, including the steps for setting up the bot and selecting accounts to interact with.

Wireframes: Low-fidelity wireframes that outline the basic layout and structure of the bot's interface. These wireframes should include screens for setting up the bot, selecting accounts to interact with, and viewing bot activity reports.

Visual design: High-fidelity visual designs that showcase the overall look and feel of the bot's interface. This includes color schemes, typography, and iconography.

First prototype: An interactive prototype that allows users to test the bot's functionality in a realistic environment. This prototype should include screens for setting up the bot, selecting accounts to interact with, and viewing bot activity reports.

Style guide: A style guide that outlines the visual design and brand guidelines for the bot. This guide should include information about colour palettes, typography, and iconography. (you can receive help on that, I have also a ux/ui designer) 

Icon library: A library of custom icons that can be used throughout the bot's interface to enhance usability and visual appeal.

User testing plan: A plan for conducting user testing to validate the bot's functionality and usability. This plan should include details about the target audience, testing methodology, and evaluation criteria.

title: Innovative news app
description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Mobile App Developer to join our team and build an innovative news app for iOS and Android platforms. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in mobile app development and be familiar with integrating advanced AI algorithms, multimedia elements, and engaging user experience features.

Key Features to Implement:

Personalized news feed: Develop an advanced AI algorithm that curates a personalized news feed for each user based on their reading habits, interests, and preferences.

Summarized content: Implement a feature that provides concise summaries of news articles, highlighting key points and main takeaways for quick and easy consumption.

Immersive multimedia experience: Integrate images, videos, and audio clips into the app to create a rich, engaging multimedia experience for users.

Real-time updates and notifications: Provide real-time news updates and push notifications based on users' preferences to keep them informed of important news and events.

Voice assistance and audio articles: Incorporate text-to-speech functionality, allowing users to listen to articles or use the app's built-in voice assistant to read the news aloud.

Interactive elements: Add interactive features like polls, quizzes, and comment sections, encouraging users to engage with the content and share their opinions.

Gamification: Implement gamification elements such as points, badges, and leaderboards to motivate users to read more articles, share content, and invite friends to use the app.

Offline reading: Enable users to download articles for offline reading, ensuring access to content without an internet connection.

Multi-language support: Provide content in multiple languages to cater to a diverse user base and allow users to access news in their preferred language.

Dark mode and customization: Include a dark mode option and customizable themes, enabling users to personalize the app's appearance according to their preferences.

Monetization: Implement a freemium model with a free, ad-supported version and a premium version offering ad-free browsing, exclusive content, and additional features.

Requirements:

Proven experience in mobile app development for iOS and Android platforms
Strong knowledge of programming languages such as Swift, Objective-C, Java, or Kotlin
Familiarity with AI algorithms, machine learning, or natural language processing
Experience with multimedia integration and text-to-speech functionality
Proficiency in UX/UI design principles and best practices
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Strong communication and collaboration abilities
Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a brief description of your experience with similar projects when applying. We look forward to hearing from you and discussing this exciting opportunity further.

title: Implement a simple mapping table for COD shipment options to an existing Custom App in Shopify
description:
PROBLEM BACKGROUND:
1. We use COD payment options for our Shopify plan (mid size plan, not basic.
2. Main store currency is EUR.
3. We have a Custom App that is initiated when a customer selects COD payments for a country that uses a local currency (RON, HUF, CZK, SEK, etc.), that is different than our main store currency (EUR), because Shopify ONLY wants to display COD payments in the stores main currency.

SHOPIFY LOGIC:
In Shopify the customer first selects shipping option and in the following step selects the payment option.

Often, the customer selects the cheaper shipping option and later still selects COD payment, which usually costs a little more.

WHAT WE NEED TO SOLVE:
We need to add a mapping table that will check customers "shipping selection" and convert this selection to the "correct shipping selection" with the correct price, so we dont have to later do it manually in our order management system (OMS).

I have added an example below. I will provide this table in .csv format, just need help with establishing the logic inside the Custom App.

SOLUTION LOGIC:
Condition to activate app: only for COD orders
First column "customer shipping selection",
Second column "correct shipping selection", 
Third column "correct price"

IF customer selects 1 (incorrect shipping for COD), we show 2 (correct shipping name) and 3 (correct COD shipping price)

Example:
VortexVR.HU
1. Hungarian customer selects COD payment and selects "Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - (1-2 nap)" instead of "Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - Utánvétel (Cash on Delivery) (1-2 nap)".

2. Than price is 1675,00 HUF instead of 2085,00 HUF. This is incorrect price, and we need to change it.

3.1 So, our COD App checks our mapping table and for column 1 for "Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - (1-2 nap)" and changes inside order to "Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - Utánvétel (Cash on Delivery) (1-2 nap)" with higer and correct price of "2085,00 HUF"

3.2 BUT, we also have another condition: order value
IF customer selected products for 60.000 HUF or more, he will be presented with 2 options:

Option 1: Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - (1-2 nap) 60000,00 HUF and up. 
Price: Free
and
Option 2: Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - Utánvétel (Cash on Delivery) (1-2 nap) 60000,00 HUF and up 
Price: 420,00 HUF

so same situation here:
we check mapping table "Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - (1-2 nap)" and for COD we should apply "Magyar Posta (MPL) - Csomagautomata - Utánvétel (Cash on Delivery) (1-2 nap)" and price should be 420 HUF

title: Data Warehouse
description:
Project Specification: Cloud-based Data Warehouse

Objectives:
a. To design and build a scalable, secure, and high-performance data warehouse on the cloud platform.
b. To provide a centralized repository for storing, processing, and analyzing large amounts of structured and unstructured data.
c. To enable data warehousing and business intelligence activities for a range of stakeholders, including data scientists, business analysts, and decision-makers.

Scope:
a. The data warehouse will be hosted on a major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
b. The data warehouse will support the ingestion and storage of structured and semi-structured data, including relational data, time-series data, and text data.
c. The data warehouse will provide an SQL interface for querying and analyzing data.
d. The data warehouse will be designed for high availability and disaster recovery.
e. The data warehouse will be secured according to industry-standard security practices.

Data Sources:
a. The data warehouse will ingest data from a range of sources, including:
i. Relational databases
ii. Flat files
iii. APIs
b. The data sources will be regularly updated and the data warehouse will reflect the latest data.

Data Processing:
a. The data warehouse will support data processing through:
i. Batch processing
ii. Stream processing
b. The data warehouse will provide an interface for scheduling and executing data processing jobs.

Data Visualization:
a. The data warehouse will support data visualization through a range of tools, including:
i. SQL-based reporting and dashboards
ii. Business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
b. The data visualization tools will be easy to use and accessible to a range of stakeholders.

Technical Architecture:
a. The data warehouse will be built on a cloud-based infrastructure, including:
i. A relational database management system (RDBMS)
ii. A data lake
iii. A data processing engine (e.g., Apache Spark)
b. The data warehouse will be designed for high performance and scalability.

Security:
a. The data warehouse will be secured according to industry-standard security practices, including:
i. Encryption of sensitive data at rest and in transit
ii. Access controls to ensure that only authorized users can access the data
iii. Regular security audits and penetration testing.

Project Timeline:
a. The project timeline will be agreed upon by all stakeholders, with regular progress updates provided.
b. The project will be completed within a specified timeframe, with a focus on delivering a high-quality solution.

title: Need a Full Stack Developer for Creating A Web App using Various APIs
description:
I want to create a web app either in Java or Python that will communicate with 4 APIs and record responses in a step-by-step manner to create content through OpenAI GPT technology.

The whole Process would be like this:

1.) App will communicate with the SpaceSerp API for a query and record the results and remove those results on the fly having negative list domains. (https://spaceserp.com/)

2.) After this, app will communicate with Frase NLP API with the same query and results received from SpaceSerp API and would receive json data containing each page's HTML data.

It will convert that json data into nicely organized view so user can select the relevant part from each page to own editor. I will show this to you over virtual call.

Apart from this, the json response also contains common words used in all pages, so app will record them also and show them on the right panel. 

3.) Once user has selected relevant sections from each page content to own editor. He will hit the command to operate next Step.

4.) Once, user has hit the command to operate next step, app will take the whole content from the User's editor and divide them into original sections and run sequential commands and generate the content through Frase Content Creation API. The Input would be Copied Section + Custom Prompt.

5.) Once concatenated all the generated content, it will run the operation of One sentence per paragraph. Then it will show side by side, Input content and concatenated generated Content. Generated Content would be editable by the User. Once he is satisfied, he can submit it to Wordpress through Rest API. The Editor would show content as Title, meta Description, Content. This final step would mark that query/keyword as completed.

To accomplish all of this, there would be one Admin Area and One Employee Area.

Admin Area will firstly Create Employees and generate their Usernames & passwords.

Then Admin will define negative list of domains as required in first communication with the SpaceSerp API.

Then Admin will create a Project and assign that to one or more Employees created in first Step. Apart from this, project details would include a text Area where I will input keywords (One per line) and define Rest API details connection with the Wordpress for that particular project.

Then In Admin Area, I will create prompts and their order of execution that are basically commands which will be used for content generation in Employee Area as stated above. It will be name of the prompt & prompt text.

Admin Area will also contain fields for Adding SpaceSerp API & Frase API.

In the Employee Area, he will see the queries which haven't been marked completed in the last step as defined above. He will Click on any pending query in his dashboard home screen and app will execute first command by communicating SpaceSerp and show him the results. He can manually add or delete any URL at this stage and click "Process". This will trigger the Second communication with Frase NLP API and receive json response and process that json file and show it in an organized way while keeping HTML tags like if it 's heading h2, h3 or h4 and it's supporting content labeled in p tag, li, ul tags, so basically everything until wither next h tag or end of document.

The user will first define the Title of Content, then define meta Description manually. Then he will choose best sections from all the received pages along with their heading and supporting content and it will be keep adding in his own editor. Once he is satisfied with his outline and content, he will press the button "Write". Then it will trigger communication with Frase API in loop, section by section and adding the content to different editor.

Once user is satisfied with the desired content, he will press submit, and it will trigger the Rest API connection with the Wordpress based on the project he is working on.

I am attaching the json file received from Frase NLP API for your reference. To convert it to excel table, you can use https://www.aconvert.com/document/json-to-xls/

title: Resource allocation for a Multi-commodity multi-warehouse and multi-destination
description:
Resource allocation for Multi-commodity, multi-warehouse and multi-destination.

Each item we have in our inventory is identified through a set of quality specifications assigned to it. The valuation of our inventory is done based on these quality parameters. These items are allocated to the sales we have made when the shipment time comes. I want to have an algorithm which will allocate the items from our inventory to these sales. The idea is to minimize the cost function i.e. total value of the item + cost of shipping applied to our sales from our inventory given certain constrains.

Some of the examples of constraints we face are
1. Sales quality: We make wide variety of sales with some of the sales have certain restrictions on the quality of cotton that can be applied to it. The algorithm should be able to handle simple algebraic functions like min, max, avg, max/min allocation from a given range.
2. Commodity origin: At times the sales are made from specific origin. The allocation needs to be from that origin.
3. Inventory quality: Since the quality specs we sell are minimum, if the inventory doesn’t have those specs then we have to apply better specs (higher value) against that sale.
4. Warehouse: Cotton can only be shipped from the whs in full container loads. A container load (20mt) consists of 100 units.
5. Time spread of sales and purchases: The sales are spread over time (each month will have certain sales) and the pace at which we inbound inventory in our whs is spread over few months.

The solution I am looking for is an optimal method of applying the inventory to sales maximizing the profits (minimizing the cost) given the constraints above.

title: Data analysis (ANOVA, descriptive statistics and correlation)
description:
The data analysis is regarding the agriculture experiment. Here I will give a brief explanation about the work I have done. 

We cultivated 72 cultivars of a crop in a field with no replications and 24 are harvested early, 24 are harvested intermediate and 24 are harvested lately.

The data I have provided has 72 different cultivars/varieties in which 24 are harvested early, 24 are harvested late and 24 are harvested intermediately. 

The purpose of this work is “ To know whether early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars differ in their germination success, biometry(seed length, width, area), TKG, yield related traits(Flowering time, pod width, pod length, plant height, seed colour and seed yield) ” 

For the germination test we performed 4 replications each cultivar is tested 4 times. For biometry we took 4 subsamples from each cultivar. For yield related traits we collected data manually. All these data are clearly provided in the excel file. 

With the provided data we have to do analysis to know whether there are any changes/differences in germination success(%), Biometry parameters and yield related parameters between early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars. 

For data analysis: 

Descriptive statistics: Min, Max, Range, Mean and CV for early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars for all the parameters mentioned.

Different cultivars where harvested at different times, so it makes sense to calculate only the average of the measurements per cultivar 
and use this as the response variable in anova and harvesting time as the explanatory variable. 

So the model could be, 
eg: average grain weight per cultivar(parameter) ~ havesting time (ordinary linear model - anova)

all the parameters can be done like the above

Or anything as per your experience which suits for this experiment.

title: NODE application that accepts Wix Stores webhooks requests
description:
The application must be a NODEJS app (in TypeScript or JS ES6) and it should answer to 2 Wix Stores order webhook requests, preferably using ExpressJS.

These are the hooks:
- Fulfillment Created Webhook [API docs](https://dev.wix.com/api/rest/wix-stores/orders/fulfillment-created-webhook)
- Fulfillment Updated Webhook [API docs](https://dev.wix.com/api/rest/wix-stores/orders/fulfillment-updated-webhook)

The application should then:
- Get the Wix Stores `orderId` and retrieve its order object [API docs](https://dev.wix.com/api/rest/wix-stores/orders/get-order)
- If that order has `fulfillmentStatus` as `FULFILLED` it should then:
 - Find the corresponding property from the Wix Store objects that corresponds with Vipps order id.
 - Then initiate a **full amount** capture with VIPPS (a Norwegian payments provider) [API docs](https://vippsas.github.io/vipps-developer-docs/docs/APIs/ecom-api/vipps-ecom-api#capture) and in detail [here](https://vippsas.github.io/vipps-developer-docs/api/ecom#tag/Vipps-eCom-API/operation/capturePaymentUsingPOST).

The application should implement the necessary logic for dealing with the authorization and/or token validation methods with both APIs.

### Definition of Done
The task is considered complete if all the described steps are implemented.

*This is a pseudo-application. That is: we just want the theoretical code that would be needed for the application to run if it were published.

title: Selling puts in US stock Market

Some possible steps to take include:

Gather data on stock prices and options prices from a financial data provider or through web scraping.
Use a programming language such as Python or R to process and clean the data.
Use a machine learning library such as scikit-learn or TensorFlow to train a model on the data.
Use the trained model to make predictions about which stock will be the most profitable to sell a put option on.
Use a framework such as Flask or Django to build a web interface or an API that allows users to access the predictions made by the bot.
Continuously monitor and update the data to improve the model predictions.
It's a very challenging task and would require understanding of financial markets, good programming skills and machine learning. Alternatively, you can use some pre-built solutions like options trading platforms with AI/ML capabilities or consulting a professional developer or data scientist.

title: Convert a web scraping bot to use Playwright+Firefox
description:
We have a partial implementation of a web crawler based on Python and UDC (undetected Chrome driver) which was designed to download and track content in real-time from the "In Play" tab of bet365.com. The site in question (bet365.com) has very advanced anti-bot detection techniques which are regularly updated. Some examples of known measures include: usage of the CloudFlare Enterprise anti-bot platform; device fingerprinting, blacklisting of known static-IP proxies; detecting VMs, virtual devices, and many headless browsers by using the WEBGL_debug_renderer_info extension and possibly other techniques; checking for Navigator.WebDriver and other "tells" that indicate the browser is being remote controlled; not loading certain content if there isn't enough mouse movements; and detecting whether dev tools is open and not loading pages/assets based on that signal. 

The list above is non-exhaustive and is just what we have observed during our ongoing development process. It is quite likely that in addition to the list above, there are other aggressive anti-bot measures in place that you would need to surpass. Overall, bet365 has a large in-house "anti-bot" team so the solution will need to be ultra-stealth and indistinguishable from a real human user. 

Our partial Python+UDC implementation was able to successfully access the needed area of the site for approximately two months but has since been blocked. Rather than continually repair the Python+UDC implementation, we are opting to upgrade to the Playwright+Firefox stack, since benchmarks suggest that this combination defeats the most commercial anti-bot systems better than any other. 

The selected candidate will be provided a copy of the Python+UDC implementation as the starting point for the porting project. Once the new Playwright+Firefox stack can access the site, we will offer ongoing work to add new features and maintain the project. 

Additional details regarding the theory of operation on how the existing app works will be provided on request.

 
ATTRIBUTES OF THE DESIRED CANDIDATE
The task requires expert-level knowledge of the Playwright+Firefox stack and web scraping in general. Experience working with Docker dev containers and setting up Docker deployments would be considered a major plus.

The ideal candidate for this position can work alone to find patterns and solutions when looking at APIs that are not within our direct control and have limited documentation, tests, and resources available. 

OTHER REQUIREMENTS
For security purposes and to provide a consistent development environment to our team, all work for this project must be completed in a cloud-based Ubuntu VM furnished by us. The VM is provisioned with adequate hardware specs to run the needed applications. Only work done within the provided VM can be submitted for payment. Any and all activity within the VM is monitored and recorded.

Time commitment:
By default, up to 40 hours weekly is budgeted in each contract. It is not possible to complete this project in a timely fashion without a full-time commitment to this project, which we define as at least 35 hours per week. Please do not apply for this position if you are unable to commit a minimum of 35 hours a week between Monday and Friday each week. This core 35-hour commitment must be done during the working week (Monday through Friday). The remaining 5 hours above the 35-hour weekly commitment can be worked any day of the week.

Core hours:
As this project involves integrating internal systems with a third-party source, a certain level of coordination is required to keep the project on track and ensure that dependencies and questions are resolved. On Tuesday through Friday each week all developers on our team participate in a "core hours" scheme from 8 AM - 11 AM UTC. This means that on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday each week, all developers must plan for three hours of their working schedule to fall during the 8AM to 11AM GMT/UTC window. The remaining working hours can be any other time of the day including directly before, directly after, or not adjacent to the core hours window.

title: Need help: Data analysis (ANOVA, descriptive statistics and correlation) (Remote)
description:
Hello,

The data analysis is regarding the agriculture experiment. Here I will give a brief explanation about the work I have done. 

We cultivated 72 cultivars of a crop in a field with no replications and 24 are harvested early, 24 are harvested intermediate and 24 are harvested lately.

The data I have provided has 72 different cultivars/varieties in which 24 are harvested early, 24 are harvested late and 24 are harvested intermediately. 

The purpose of this work is “ To know whether early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars differ in their germination success, biometry(seed length, width, area), TKG, yield related traits(Flowering time, pod width, pod length, plant height, seed colour and seed yield) ” 

For the germination test we performed 4 replications each cultivar is tested 4 times. For biometry we took 4 subsamples from each cultivar. For yield related traits we collected data manually. All these data are clearly provided in the excel file. 

With the provided data we have to do analysis to know whether there are any changes/differences in germination success(%), Biometry parameters and yield related parameters between early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars. 

For data analysis: 

Descriptive statistics: Min, Max, Range, Mean and CV for early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars for all the parameters mentioned.

Different cultivars where harvested at different times, so it makes sense to calculate only the average of the measurements per cultivar 
and use this as the response variable in anova and harvesting time as the explanatory variable. 

So the model could be, 
eg: average grain weight per cultivar(parameter) ~ havesting time (ordinary linear model - anova)

all the parameters can be done like the above

Or anything as per your experience which suits for this experiment.
